title: Sales Cycle: Order → Delivery → Invoice → Receipt
intro:
भाग 4 — Trading का पूरा चक्र

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 2 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Sales Order से Delivery Note, Invoice और Rejection In तक पूरा चक्र चलाना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Sales Order (Alt+F5) → Delivery Note (Alt+F8) → Sales Invoice (F8)

Customer से माल वापसी पर Rejection In (Ctrl+F6) / Credit Note

Pending Sales Orders Report से Follow-up

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Delivery Note के बाद Invoice में Delivery Reference न चुनना

Partial Delivery में Qty गलत भरना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Sales Order (Alt+F5), Delivery Note (Alt+F8), Sales Invoice (F8) व Rejection In (Ctrl+F6) का प्रयोग करें; पहले F10 दबाकर ये Voucher Types Activate करें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Pass the full Sales Order → Delivery Note → Sales Invoice → Rejection In cycle in Tally Prime and check Sales Bill Pending / Sales Order Outstanding reports.
guide:
Sales Cycle: Order → Delivery → Invoice → Receipt

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Sales Cycle के Steps

  • F11 (Features) → Order Processing = Yes। F10 से Voucher Types Activate करें।
  • Sales Order: Alt+F5 → Party, Order No., Due Date, Items, Rate।
  • Delivery Note: Alt+F8 → Party, Tracking No., Order का Reference (Against Order), जितना माल असल में भेजा उतनी Qty।
  • Sales Invoice: F8 → Delivery Note का Reference (Against Delivery Note), जितनी Qty का Bill बनाना है।
  • ग्राहक ने माल लौटाया तो Rejection In (Ctrl+F6) — Stock वापस आएगा; Accounts के लिए Credit Note (Ctrl+F8)।
  • बाकी Order रद्द करना हो तो Pre-Close करें।
  • Reports: Display More Reports → Statements of Inventory → Sales Order Outstanding / Sales Bills Pending।
याद रखें

Sales Order और Delivery Note का Accounts पर असर नहीं (सिर्फ़ Stock पर, Delivery Note का)।

Invoice में Delivery का Reference न चुनने पर Pending खुला रह जाता है।

Partial Delivery में Quantity ध्यान से भरें।

Pre-Close

Pre-Close का विकल्प Order Outstanding Report या Voucher की Order Details में मिलता है। नाम Tally Version के अनुसार थोड़ा अलग हो सकता है।
outro:
💡 Self-Check (मौखिक/Concept)

  • Delivery Note का Accounts पर असर?
  • Invoice कब बनता है?
  • Rejection In क्यों?

problems.title: Mehta Electronics — Basic Sales Order Cycle
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

Opening Stock (1st April, FY) — Door Bell: 1,500 Pcs @ ₹120; Water Tank Bell: 400 Pcs @ ₹160

  • 1st April — Sales Order (No. J-01, due 1st May) received from Jatin Gupta: 500 Pcs Door Bell @ ₹150; 500 Pcs Water Tank Bell @ ₹200
  • 2nd April — Delivery Note (Tracking No. 1): Door Bell 500 Pcs (Fully Delivered); Water Tank Bell 400 Pcs (Stock Issue — 100 Pcs short)
  • 2nd April — Sales Invoice raised: Door Bell 300 Pcs; Water Tank Bell 200 Pcs
  • 2nd April — 50 Pcs Door Bell rejected by the buyer (Rejection In); Pre-Close the remaining 50 Pcs outstanding Water Tank Bell order
problems.hint:
• Opening Stock (1 Apr): Door Bell 1,500 @ 120; Water Tank Bell 400 @ 160।
  • 1 Apr: Sales Order J-01 (Jatin Gupta, Due 1 May): Door Bell 500 @ 150; Water Tank Bell 500 @ 200।
  • 2 Apr: Delivery Note (Tracking 1): Door Bell 500; Water Tank Bell 400 (100 कम — Stock नहीं था)।
  • 2 Apr: Sales Invoice: Door Bell 300; Water Tank Bell 200।
  • 2 Apr: Rejection In — Door Bell 50 Pcs। Water Tank Bell का बाकी 50 Pcs Order Pre-Close करें।

problems.title: Aryan Bartan Manufacturer — Two Buyers, Partial Delivery  &  Rejection
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

Opening Stock (1st April, FY) — Spoon (10 Grm): 300 Pcs @ ₹10; Plate (50 Grm): 300 Pcs @ ₹50; Glass (40 Grm): 300 Pcs @ ₹40; Tiffin (50 Grm): 300 Pcs @ ₹50

  • 1st May — Sales Order (DUG-01, due 2nd June) from Duggal Bartan Store: 150 Pcs Spoon @ ₹12; 250 Pcs Plate @ ₹60
  • 1st May — Sales Order (AGG-01, due 2nd June) from Aggarwal Bartan Store: 260 Pcs Glass @ ₹48; 180 Pcs Tiffin @ ₹60
  • 1st June — Delivery Note: Duggal Bartan Store — fully delivered; Aggarwal Bartan Store — all delivered except 5 Pcs Glass and 10 Pcs Tiffin (outstanding)
  • 2nd June — Sales Invoice: Duggal Bartan Store — Spoon 100, Plate 200; Aggarwal Bartan Store — Glass 250, Tiffin 170
  • 2nd June — Rejection In: Aggarwal Bartan Store returned 5 Pcs Glass
  • 2nd June — Pre-Close all outstanding order dues for Glass and Tiffin
problems.hint:
• Opening Stock: Spoon 300 @ 10; Plate 300 @ 50; Glass 300 @ 40; Tiffin 300 @ 50।
  • 1 May: SO DUG-01 (Duggal): Spoon 150 @ 12; Plate 250 @ 60। SO AGG-01 (Aggarwal): Glass 260 @ 48; Tiffin 180 @ 60। Due 2 June।
  • 1 Jun: Delivery Note — Duggal पूरी Delivery (Spoon 150, Plate 250); Aggarwal: Glass 255 (5 कम), Tiffin 170 (10 कम)।
  • 2 Jun: Sales Invoice — Duggal: Spoon 100, Plate 200; Aggarwal: Glass 250, Tiffin 170।
  • 2 Jun: Rejection In — Aggarwal से Glass 5 Pcs।
  • 2 Jun: Glass और Tiffin की बची Order Quantity Pre-Close करें।

problems.title: TechZone Traders — GST Sales Cycle with Credit Note
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

सभी Items पर 18% GST (CGST 9% + SGST 9%) लगाएँ — Customer और Seller एक ही State में हैं।

  • 1st April — Sales Order (TZ-101, due 2nd April) received from Prime Infotech: 20 Pcs Laptop @ ₹45,000; 50 Pcs Mouse @ ₹500
  • 2nd April — Delivery Note: Laptop 18 Pcs (2 Pcs short in stock); Mouse 50 Pcs (Full)
  • 2nd April — Sales Invoice: Laptop 15 Pcs; Mouse 50 Pcs
  • 30th April — Prime Infotech returned 2 Pcs Laptop from the invoiced quantity (Credit Note)

  • 2 Apr: Sales Invoice: Laptop 15; Mouse 50।
